reasoning_traces.think:
The core tension lies in balancing corporate control over Zenoti with decentralized task automation. The system must operate under two regimes: one where API access is granted, and another where it relies on email-based data export. The Zenoti system of record acts as a deterministic kernel, while Harmonyze introduces stochastic inference layers for performance prediction. n8n functions as a hybrid automaton, transitioning between API-driven and email-driven data ingestion. Each primitive operates within its own domain but interfaces through shared semantic structures—checklists, task types, and employee profiles. Failure modes include API expiration, data loss during email parsing, and misalignment between task definitions in Zenoti and Outlook. The dual-layered design ensures robustness against single points of failure.
